name: Mean Girls
overview:
The show follows four girls from the city of Dimona who form a girl band called “Yeladot Raot” (“Bad Girls”) after winning a local music competition, and move to Tel Aviv in hopes of building a successful music career.

As the story unfolds, the girls face the pressures and temptations of the Israeli music industry - fame, ambition, romance, betrayal, and complicated friendships.
